articles.title: OpenAI seeks $30 billion in funding at whopping $1.4 trillion valuation after delaying IPO
articles.snippet: The ChatGPT maker is pursuing fresh funding after delaying its public listing, while expanding its AI tools despite mounting safety concerns.

articles.title: Kalshi in advanced talks to raise new funding at $40B valuation: Reuters
articles.snippet: The prediction market was valued at $22 billion in a $1 billion funding round just four months ago, after doubling its valuation from December.

articles.title: OpenAI valuation could hit $1.4T in new funding round: Report
articles.snippet: OpenAI is reportedly seeking another $30 billion from investors as the ChatGPT developer pushes its long-awaited public market debut into 2027.

articles.title: Coinbase-Backed Crypto Group Reveals Midterm Endorsements After Clarity Act Collapse
articles.snippet: The Coinbase-backed group's first Senate endorsements—Republicans Jon Husted and Ashley Hinson and Democrat Chris Pappas—come two weeks after the Clarity Act's collapse, as the industry's fight shifts to the campaign trail.

articles.title: US Senator Blumenthal Calls Tether's USDT a 'Superhighway' for Iranian Sanctions Evasion
articles.snippet: The Connecticut Senator's subcommittee released its report on Monday and referred the findings to Treasury and the Justice Department.
